RISING.docs: Trigger only on rising edge (low to high)

FALLING.docs: Trigger only on falling edge (high to low)

ANY.docs: Trigger on any edge change (high to low or low to high)

interrupt_type.docs:
**string**: The type of interrupt to use. One of:

*See also: [GPIO Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/gpio#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin to monitor.

*See also: [GPIO Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/gpio#configuration-variables)*

use_interrupt.docs:
**boolean**: Use hardware interrupts instead of polling for better performance and lower CPU usage. Defaults to `true` for most platforms, but defaults to `false` for LibreTiny-based platforms (BK72xx, RTL87xx, LN882x) due to hardware limitations. Only supported on internal GPIO pins.

*See also: [GPIO Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/gpio#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation. Required if you have multiple busses.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via GPIO](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/gpio#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**number**: The pin which will be use for bus communication. Note that 1-wire is a bi-directional bus so the selected GPIO pin must support both input and output. This must be a GPIO pin internal to the microcontroller and cannot be a pin located on an I/O expander or similar device.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via GPIO](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/gpio#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this output component.

*See also: [GPIO Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/gpio#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin to turn on and off.

*See also: [GPIO Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/gpio#configuration-variables)*

interlock.docs:
**list**: A list of other GPIO switches in an interlock group. See [Interlocking](https://esphome.io/components/switch/gpio#interlocking).

*See also: [GPIO Switch](https://esphome.io/components/switch/gpio#configuration-variables)*

interlock_wait_time.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: For interlocking mode, set how long to wait after other items in an interlock group have been disabled before re-activating. Useful for motors where immediately turning on in the other direction could cause problems.

*See also: [GPIO Switch](https://esphome.io/components/switch/gpio#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The GPIO pin to use for the switch.

*See also: [GPIO Switch](https://esphome.io/components/switch/gpio#configuration-variables)*
